text: {"summary":"Example Distribution FZE, a building-materials distributor, wants to replace end-of-day stock spreadsheets with a stock control system. Warehouse staff would record receipts and dispatches as they happen, sales staff would see current stock before confirming orders, the system would raise reorder alerts, and finance would get a monthly stock valuation. This first draft covers objectives, stakeholders, functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, user stories, assumptions, dependencies and open questions. The two documents conflict on the number of warehouses: the brief says one, the site visit notes say three. That conflict, items without barcodes, the accounting package connection, reorder thresholds and the average cost method are raised as open questions for the customer.
